description: Compute simple moving average (SMA) and exponential moving average (EMA) series from a list of numbers and a window size, a foundational technical-indicator building block for price/volume data. No live market-data feed is involved: this operates only on numbers you supply.

values.description: A non-empty series of finite numbers, e.g. daily closing prices

windowSize.description: The trailing window size for both SMA and EMA, must not exceed values.length

name: calculate_moving_averages
